messages:
alex: Hey team — Alex here, started today. Trying to bootstrap my dev env. On a MacBook Pro M1, installed asdf and added nodejs 18.16.0 and ruby 3.1.2 but `node -v` shows v16. Any pointers? Also my ~/.zshrc doesn't seem to source .asdf/asdf.sh so asdf commands sometimes act weird. Thanks!
sam_onboard: hey alex, welcome! First quick checks: did you add `source ~/.asdf/asdf.sh` and `source ~/.asdf/completions/asdf.bash` (or the zsh equivalent) to your ~/.zshrc, and restart your shell? Also what's the output of `asdf current nodejs` and `which node`?
alex: `asdf current nodejs` -> "nodejs (none)". I ran `asdf install nodejs 18.16.0` and `asdf list` shows 18.16.0. `which node` -> /usr/local/bin/node (looks like brew).
maria_infra: yup brew's node is shadowing asdf shims. Two quick fixes: uninstall brew node `brew uninstall node` if you don't need it, or ensure `.asdf/shims` is at the front of your PATH by adding `export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/shims:$PATH"` near the top of your .zshrc (before any brew path modifications). Also run `asdf reshim nodejs` after install.
alex: thanks — checking now. Quick follow-up: env var guidance? Should I put test API keys in `.env.local` in repo, or use a secrets shim?
ryan-platform: for local dev, use `.env.local` and never commit it. We include `dotfiles/.env.example` for values you need to fill in. For anything that touches staging/prod or shared creds, request Vault access (infra will provision a `~/redwood-secrets` symlink once you have perms). Ping infra if you need Vault permissions.
alex: moved the PATH export above brew stuff and restarted the terminal — `node -v` now shows v18.16.0, yay. About dotfiles: should I fork the company's dotfiles repo and run a script, or is there a recommended flow?
sam_onboard: clone https://github.com/redwood/dotfiles and run `make link` from the repo root. It symlinks profiles into your home. If you want to experiment, fork it and keep your changes in a branch, but we usually just clone and open a PR for any upstream-friendly tweaks. If linking fails, tell me and we can pair for 15m.
devex_bot: Welcome @alex! Onboarding checklist updated — please mark "dev env configured" when you're done: https://redwood.in/onboarding/checklist :party_parrot:
alex: also trying to add python and go plugins to asdf — `asdf plugin-add python` errors out complaining about gpg keys on M1. Any tips?
maria_infra: install gpg with brew `brew install gpg`, then add the plugin explicitly: `asdf plugin-add python https://github.com/danhper/asdf-python.git`. If you still hit GPG key import errors, run `gpg --keyserver keyserver.ubuntu.com --recv-keys <KEYID>` for the missing key reported by the plugin. If you get stuck with arm64 build deps, run `brew install openssl readline sqlite3 xz zlib` and then `ASDF_PYTHON_BUILD_MALLOC=system asdf install python <version>` as a fallback.
alex: followed your steps, gpg installed, plugin added, python installed. Everything working now. Thanks so much for the quick help — really appreciate the warm onboarding! :rocket:
